##### Project general facts

Piazza Roma by DAMAC is a striking development within DAMAC Lagoons, designed to bring together stylish living and modern business in one thoughtfully planned destination. The project offers premium office spaces, creating a versatile and sophisticated environment for working.

The development features a vibrant mall with a supermarket, restaurants, kids’ zone, lifestyle stores, art spaces and pop-up retail, making everyday needs and leisure experiences conveniently available within the community.

Office and mall interiors are refined, with sophisticated lobbies, modern workspaces and stylish retail environments that create a polished and welcoming atmosphere throughout the development.

##### Location description and benefits

DAMAC Lagoons is a vibrant residential community developed by DAMAC Properties. Nestled within a serene environment, this community offers an oasis of tranquility amidst the bustling city. 

Designed with a focus on modern living, the community features thoughtfully planned spaces, combining comfort and style. Residents can enjoy the benefits of low-rise living while still having access to the amenities and conveniences essential for a contemporary lifestyle.

DAMAC Lagoons is not only a residential space but also an embodiment of community living, offering a balanced and fulfilling lifestyle. With its strategic location and thoughtful design, Damac Lagoons provides residents with a harmonious blend of comfort, convenience, and a sense of community in the heart of Dubai.
